column1: # Commander precon win rates — gate G4's ground truth (design §13.2)
# Corpus:      67 decks, 11,855 tracked games played with the stock decklist
# Normalised:  4-player, 25% baseline. ORDINAL transfer only — this simulator
#              is 2-player, so the ranks are usable and the rates are not.
# Gated at:    >= 20 games from >= 10 distinct pilots (the source's own filter)
# Transcribed by hand because no API or bulk export is offered. The transcription
# is checked two ways rather than trusted: the row count must be 67 and the games
# column must sum to 11,855, which is the total the page states for itself. Both
# hold. A transcription that dropped or invented a row would miss one or both.
# `mtgjson_name` is the deck's name in the MTGJSON AllDeckFiles bulk that
# tools/fetch-precons.sh consumes, and it is spelled out rather than derived
# because five of the 67 differ from Playgroup's spelling. Four are the Final
# Fantasy decks, which MTGJSON suffixes with their sub-title; their "Collector's
# Edition" variants were checked and carry an IDENTICAL 100-card list, so the
# base list is used and the choice changes nothing. The fifth is Playgroup's
# "Mind Flayarrgh" against MTGJSON's "Mind Flayarrrs", which is the product's
# printed name; there is one Baldur's Gate deck it could be, so the match is
